title: Qibnaytiino too meysi bahte
intro: umaane edde radde magaalal, inki ayro qammalsime wayta gufne abe. ken nagaytaniinah bohoy, ta num kalalu xayyoose, takkay immay magaalah ummatta tukteenay qaybik tani esserte. xayyowte qawwalaylah maabitina, taama abeynit buxa mara luk dite reebih addat kudde, finqah asta elle heen magaala darrel cabe. Ah dubuk yaamine num miyyaay?
clues: Anu qaybi abtootat yengeleh yan marah farmoytah ruube.
qammalsime wayte gufneh yi buxa temeeteeh, anu inni nagaynak muxxi ken nagaynaanah kaxxam cisabboteh suge.
Yi ummatta yi qibina uma niya luk yableenim esserteeh, anu ken lih sabab abam gabbate.
Yi gufneh yemeete mari sinnih malaykoota kinnim qaddoysaanam kee yi buxah mara beyaanam kee bar gexuh yoo amrisen.
Yi barra kudah seeco maabbinnaay, yi ummattah innah tan finqa foocal kaat garayte.
yi magaala robti xaahi robti kallayto, tet fayyale exxaaxi addah bahte.
